item.title: Clark ‘Corky’ McNutt
item.description: Clark “Corky” McNutt, age 93, passed away peacefully on Feb. 13, 2026, in Elma, Washington. Born on Oct. 15, 1932, in Tacoma, Washington, Clark lived a long and fulfilling life marked by dedication to his family, education, and service.
